newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Aranypok says public bond issue subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Aranypok says public bond issue subscribed.

text.p: Hungarian clothes retailer Aranypok Kereskedelmi Rt closed a public bond issue with the whole 100 million forint package on offer sold.
Aranypok and lead manager Dunainvest Kft said that the bonds were not oversubscribed.
Aranypok sought to raise between 70 million and 100 million forints via a bond issue with subscriptions running between May 28 and 30, to finance further developments of its outlets.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Aranypok shares have remained untraded since May 20 when they closed at 7,100 forints.
